messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: Canary health alert — southwest region — spike in 5xx for bluepush-v3 canary. Severity: SEV2. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/3315557777 :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: Acknowledged, I’m on it.
sre-jordan: Looking at metrics — 5xx spike started ~3315557600. Errors mostly 502/503 upstream from edge -> runtime.
eng-runtime-maria: We pushed bluepush-v3 earlier with new keepalive/socket tuning. Could be exposing LB connection limits.
oncall-alex: Reproducing: curl to sw-edge returns 502 consistently for some requests.
oncall-alex: `curl -v https://sw-edge.redwood.ai/health` -> repeated `502 Bad Gateway`.
infra-tyler: Checking traffic manager — southwest pool weight for bluepush-v3 jumped to 40% around 3315557550, expected 10%. Noted manual override?
sre-jordan: Rollout controller logs show weight step overshot due to cooldown logic race. That would explain sudden load.
oncall-alex: Paging eng-runtime for quick rollback/kill-switch. @eng-runtime-maria please advise.
eng-runtime-maria: Confirmed. Recommend kill-switch then rollback to bluepush-v2. Initiating kill-switch now.
oncall-alex: Executing kill-switch: `./ops/flags set bluepush-v3.enabled false --region=sw`
ops-bot: Kill-switch action recorded by ops-bot (runbook: rollback-flow).
incident-bot: Kill-switch acknowledged. Traffic routing policy should fallback to stable variant per policy. Monitoring immediate effect.
sre-jordan: 5xx rate dropping ~65% in the metrics. Good. Note: many clients still hitting 5xx due to DNS TTL and active connections.
infra-tyler: Manually adjusted DNS weights to move remaining traffic off the canary and set bluepush-v3 weight to 0% in traffic manager. Also decreased TTL to 30s to speed propagation.
eng-runtime-maria: Starting rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/bluepush --to-revision=2` -> rollout started.
support-ana: I'm seeing 9 support tickets from enterprise customers in SW region — reported timeouts and 502s. Escalating to account teams.
product-lee: Drafting customer note: "We've mitigated a partial rollout impact in southwest region. Root cause investigation underway; rollback completed for affected traffic." Will share soon.
sre-jordan: Observed some long-lived upstream connections causing backend saturation. Need postmortem to include connection/keepalive change and rollout controller weight race.
oncall-alex: Leaving runbook notes: rollback initiated, DNS weight adjusted, kill-switch flipped, monitoring for 30m. Handoff to night-sre in 2 hours.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-9342. Runbook entry: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9342
infra-tyler: Propagation note: TTL reduction should finish ~ 30s but some resolvers honor older TTLs — will monitor.
support-ana: Notifying affected customers now with interim message and status page update.
eng-runtime-maria: Rollback completion detected: stable pods up and healthy. Edge 5xxs down ~90% from peak.
sre-jordan: Marking mitigation successful. Still keeping incident open for postmortem and monitoring window.
product-lee: Assigning postmortem lead: @sre-jordan (primary), @eng-runtime-maria (config owner), @infra-tyler (routing).
oncall-alex: If anything degrades re-page me. Otherwise I'll close the on-call page in 30m once stability confirmed.
ops-bot: Handoff checklist posted to INC-9342. Next steps: timeline, config diffs, rollback script review, rollout controller fix.
support-ana: Sent customer follow-ups. Affected customer list attached to incident.
sre-jordan: I'll take primary on postmortem. ETA draft in 48h.
product-lee: Thanks everyone — good coordination. :thumbsup:
oncall-alex: Monitoring continues, standing by.
